changelog:
- LLM MOD CREATION: new Create Mod option in the Mods tab — describe a mod idea and the LLM creates it as a JSON block or GDScript mod. Nothing installs without your Install tap: you review a plain-language summary + the full code first.
- Generated mods go through the same strict validation as hand-written mods (schema + forbidden-API scan). Invalid generations are rejected, never installed.
- Installed LLM-made mods are normal mods: they appear in the Mods tab and the LLM can compose with them in later Forge requests.
- No other gameplay changes in this build.
